In both price-responsive mechanisms, we schedule individual EV charging to minimize charging costs subject to Eqs. 2.3–2.5, 2.9, 2.10, and 2.12 for each vehicle.2 The only difference between the two price-responsive mechanisms is their hourly price profiles. The PLEXOS day-ahead model simulated using the unmanaged EV charging profile supplies the hourly RTP profile. We calculate TOU rates to minimize the mean absolute difference between the resulting TOU price schedule and the hourly RTP subject to structural constraints on number of seasons and blocks, minimum number of days in a season, and minimum number of hours in a block.
